thread:
Alex: Heads-up — seeing a p50/p99 regression for streamed responses when early-ack + prefetch are both enabled on rtx-prod. Repro steps below, can anyone confirm?
Marta: Can you paste the repro command and the profile output?
Alex: Repro (run on canary host):
```bash
./run_infer --model redwood-small --stream --early-ack --prefetch-kv=512 --token-budget=64 --duration=60s
# p50: 82ms -> 102ms, p99: 320ms -> 400ms (after 2026-03-10 runtime roll)
```
Sam: We did land the new small-kernel handoff in 2026.03.09 which changes decode slice sizes and kernel selection heuristics. Could be interaction with partial-decode scheduling.
Jin: Also saw KV warmup hits: requests that early-ack before KV prefetch finishes cause partial-decode to block waiting on KV reads and force extra small kernels. That spikes latency.
Priya: If early-ack lets the client stream tokens before our KV is warm, the runtime races: client expects packets, decode stalls, then we do immediate kernel switches.
perf-bot: Canary metrics: streaming endpoints with early-ack enabled show +25% CPU and +80ms p99 in the last deploy window (link: https://perf.redwood/canary/2145).
qa-ops: Reproduced locally with the above cmd. The trace shows repeated "kv-miss -> kernel-fallback" cycles.
Marta: Sounds like we need a guard: gate early-ack until a minimal prefetched KV threshold or until first decode slice completes. Also consider lowering token_budget target for streaming to reduce partial-decode slice size.
Alex: Proposal for quick experiment (A/B):
```yaml
streaming:
  early_ack: true
  early_ack_min_prefetch_kv: 256
  token_budget_target: 48  # reduce slice size for streaming-heavy requests
  queue_policy: fairness_weight: 0.6  # bias against long-prefetch jobs in admission
```
Sam: Also try pinning kernel-selection to "stable-small" for the canary to see if kernel churn is the main culprit. If p99 drops, kernel selection + transient KV stalls are the combo.
Jin: I can add a fast-path: if prefetch queue length < 2 and early_ack is set, hold ack for first decode slice completion (50ms cap). That prevents immediate streaming from outrunning KV.
Priya: Let's also add a microprofile that logs kernel-switch counts per request and partial-decode wait time so we can correlate.
Alex: Action items: Jin to demo early_ack gating patch, Sam to run kernel pin canary, Marta to collect per-request kernel-switch logs and upload profiler. I'll open an issue with reproduction and lab numbers.
qa-ops: assigning smoke to @qa-ops, will run regression matrix after canary. :thumbsup:
Alex: thanks — will post updates in the thread when we have canary numbers.
